items:
Come on over to Kool Beanz, where every detail has been curated for the dream Destin getaway. This spacious 6-bedroom retreat welcomes up to 22 guests, making it the perfect destination for your next large group adventure.

As you arrive, palm trees swaying in the front yard will instantly transport you to a beachy paradise. The charming front porch greets you with rocking chairs - the ideal spot for your morning coffee. The exterior of the home, painted in seafoam green with bright purple trim, exudes cheerful beachy vibes, setting the tone for your beach escape.

Step inside to discover coastal charm at every turn. Three comfortable sofas in the living area invite you to kick back and relax. The modern kitchen features stainless steel appliances and is fully equipped for your convenience. Complete with sleek countertops, barstool seating, and an island for additional prep space, the kitchen makes cooking for your crew a breeze! Two indoor dining areas provide plenty of space for your group.

For alfresco meals, head to the backyard oasis. Here, a private pool awaits, surrounded by a poolside patio with sun loungers and two dining tables. A shaded gazebo is home to a third outdoor dining table, making it the ideal spot for poolside lunches on sunny days. This private poolside paradise ensures endless fun - cool off with a dip in the pool, play a game of cornhole on the back porch, and enjoy quality time with your family and friends.

When you're ready to explore, Kool Beanz's prime location puts you just a few blocks from the beach, where you can enjoy sun, sand, and ocean waves to your heart's content! Plus, with nearby golf courses, shopping, and dining options, there's something for everyone to enjoy.

With beds for 22 guests - 5 bedrooms in the main house and an additional bedroom in the separate pool house - everyone will have a comfortable space to rest and recharge after a day of fun. Additional amenities, including a laundry room and parking, will ensure a stress-free stay.

Experience the ultimate Destin getaway at Kool Beanz - book your stay today and get ready for a vacation filled with fun, relaxation, and memories that will last a lifetime!

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we’re at your fingertips!

Local Attractions: Destin Commons, Silversands Outlets, Crab Island, Dolphin Tours, Charter Offshore Fishing, Big Kahuna’s Water and Adventure Park, Crackings., Louisiana Lagniappe, Jackacuda’s Seafood + Sushi

Located in Northwest Florida, Destin is dubbed the “world's luckiest fishing village.” This Emerald Coast city is known for its sparkling white beaches, numerous golf courses, and world-famous fishing. Nearby zipline courses, dolphin cruises, and amusement parks make it a perfect destination for families. Adults and large groups also come here for beach parties during the day and live music at night.

Home Truths:
- Please note that active commercial and residential construction is currently underway in the city of Destin.
- Please note that pool heat is available for an additional fee, but must be requested at least 48 hours before your stay.
- Please note: Pool heat will not be available during the summer months (April 1 - October 31).
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- There is parking space available for 3 cars
- No street parking is allowed. Street parking will be subject to fines by the city of Destin

---

The room configuration is as follows:

Primary Bedroom / King bed, twin bed
Bedroom 2 / King bed, twin bed
Bedroom 3 / Queen bed
Bedroom 4 / 2 Queen beds
Bedroom 5 / Twin over full bunk bed, twin bed
Bedroom 6 / Twin over full bunk bed, 2 twin beds

---

This is a smoke-free property. Violation of the no-smoking policy will result in forfeiture of the security deposit, a $300 smoking fee, and liability for any fire or property damage costs.

As part of our commitment to being good neighbors, occupancy limits and quiet hours (9pm-8am) are strictly enforced. No speakers or sound systems will be provided for use in our properties. Violation of any noise ordinances will be subject to fines that can reach up to $10,000 per violation.

Events or parties are not allowed without prior written approval and an additional fee. Any unauthorized parties or events will be shut down and a fine will be assessed. Please inquire for more information about our event policies and fees.

There is nothing more important to us at AvantStay than the health, safety, and experience of our guests & staff.

We've enhanced our cleaning and sanitation protocols and are taking extra care to disinfect all surfaces between reservations with hospital-grade disinfecting solutions.

As a reminder, we do work with 3rd party vendors to maintain the property, and although we adhere to the strictest CDC guidelines and advise all contractors to wear PPE equipment, we can not always enforce. We strongly advise guests to please deny access if any vendors fail to meet and adhere to these standards.

IDs will be requested for verification after booking. All bookings over 28 days require a security deposit.

We report and prosecute all Credit Card Fraud.
